PART  
1.4  

After Re-entrant Fires | Multi-point Room Unit Fires  

- Multi-point ignition of room units through broken windows  
- Subsequent façade fire spread to non-ignited units  
- Subsequent internal fire spread through front doors  
- Continuous fire development and internal & external spread from units to units  
- Buildings with multi-point room fires prevent effective firefighting operation  

![Image showing fire at Wang Fuk Court with multiple points of ignition and firefighting efforts]
